newsitem.title: UK: Panamaxes remain firm, BFI up 22 points.
newsitem.headline: Panamaxes remain firm, BFI up 22 points.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose 22 on Wednesday to 1,221 points.
Brokers said despite one or two weak fixtures of elderly Panamaxes for 50,000 heavy grain USGulf to China for early November at $20.50/$21.25, the Panamax market remained firm.

Short period chartering is becoming a feature of the market - Captain John L 64,584 dwt was fixed by Klaveness delivery West Med prompt for 4-6 months delivery Atlantic at $9,000 daily and there were reports that Endeavour 71,200 dwt was fixed by BTG delivery Far East for a similar period at between $9,800 daily and $10,250 daily.
Brokers reported more activity for Capers in the Pacific and the N.Atlanic continued firm for Handy-sizes.
BIFFEX resumed its uptrend after Tuesday's brief downward correction and by 1200 GMT it was between 10 and 15 points higher in a turnover of 80 lots.
